help.title: About Speech Studio
help.intro: Speech Studio voices text and recognises speech on your computer: the models run on your graphics card, and the cloud is used only where you turn it on.
how: Download the models on the first run: the studio picks the set for your graphics card.
Speech: write or paste a text, pick a voice and voice it.
Listening: open a recording, a link or the microphone and get the text with the speakers.
Save the result where you want it.
features: Voice cloning from a few seconds of a recording
Your own library of voices with photos and tags
Higgs Audio v3 locally, Drama 3 on cards with 24 GB
Speakers told apart in a recording
Cloud voices and recognition through OpenRouter and Google
An agent (MCP) drives the studio while you watch
sections: Listening: recognising speech and checking a voicing
Settings (⚙): models, cloud, network, agent, statistics
help.donateIntro: I build open-source software and do AI research. Most of what I create is free and available to everyone. Your donations help me keep creating and researching without worrying about where the next meal comes from =) Thank you 🙏

setup.title: First run
setup.subtitle: Speech Studio needs a few components before the first voicing. Everything needed is already checked: click Download selected at the bottom.
setup.pickNote: What's needed is already checked. Quants are variants of the same model (OR): higher quant = better quality and heavier, lower = lighter. No need to download them all.
setup.quantHint: One variant per model. Higher quant = better quality, more VRAM and disk; lower = lighter.
setup.noVram: Will not fit this card's video memory, so there is no point downloading it.
setup.noVramGroup: No variant fits this card's video memory: run this stage on a server or in the cloud, with the preset above.
setup.reinstallHint: Ships with the app — reinstall if missing
setup.owed: To start, these are still needed: {{list}}.
setup.cloudHint: Picked Cloud and entered the key? You can skip the heavy local models below: voicing and recognition will go through OpenRouter.

downloads.errDiskSpace: Not enough free space in the models folder
downloads.errHash: Checksum mismatch — the damaged file was deleted; retry to download it again
downloads.errSize: The file size differs from the pinned one — the source has changed
downloads.errRateLimited: The server kept refusing for 20 minutes — try again later
downloads.errNetwork: Network error — check the connection or the proxy
downloads.errProxy: The proxy address is invalid — check it in Settings
downloads.errNotRemovable: This component is not installed by the app
downloads.gpuNoNvidia: No NVIDIA driver found. Local stages will run on the CPU (slower) or in the cloud.
downloads.gpuNoDevice: The NVIDIA driver is installed, but no NVIDIA graphics card is visible. Local stages will run on the CPU or in the cloud.
downloads.gpuCudaInit: The NVIDIA driver did not respond. Reinstall or update it — until then local stages run on the CPU.
downloads.gpuDriverOld: Driver {{driver}} supports CUDA {{cuda}}, but the GPU engines need driver {{min}} or newer (CUDA 13). Update the driver — until then local stages run on the CPU.
downloads.gpuTooOld: {{name}} (compute capability {{cc}}) is older than Turing ({{min}}), which CUDA 13 requires. Local stages will run on the CPU or in the cloud.
downloads.phaseWaiting: Waiting for another download of the same components…
downloads.paused: Paused — what was downloaded is kept
downloads.interrupted: Interrupted when the app closed — it will continue where it stopped
downloads.removeConfirm: This frees {{size}}. You can download it again at any time.
downloads.removeErrors: Some files could not be deleted (in use by a running engine?)
downloads.importErrors: Some files could not be imported

agent.title: Agent (MCP)
agent.intro: An agent connected here (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others) drives the studio: it downloads the models, manages your voices and keys, fetches recordings by a link and works in this window while you watch. The server runs with the studio; there is nothing to install.

agent.config: Claude Desktop, Cursor and other clients
agent.failed: Could not read the agent's status

bridge.changedByWindow: The project was changed in another window; undo starts from here
bridge.changedWhileAway: The project changed while the window was away; undo starts from here
bridge.undoRefused: Not applied: the agent or another window saved the project after this state. The current project is shown

url.cookiesTip: For a video that needs a signed-in browser (age check, channel members, “confirm you're not a bot”): export cookies.txt from a browser signed in to the site with a cookies.txt extension.
url.subsHint: Subtitles made by people come into the project as imported subtitles — more accurate than speech recognition.
url.subsAuto: The site's automatic subtitles are not taken: the studio's speech recognition is more accurate.
url.ready: The video is ready: choose the mode below and press “{{start}}” — or “{{manual}}” to work on the subtitles by hand.
url.rights: Download only what you have the right to use: the author of the video and the site's rules decide.
url.toolMissing: To download a video by its link, download the yt-dlp component in Settings → Models → Download by link.
url.interrupted: Stopped when the app closed — continues from where it stopped

warn.subs_missing: The video has no subtitles made by people in that language — the project was created without them.
warn.subs_failed: The site's subtitles did not download — the project was created without them.
warn.subs_empty: The site's subtitles are empty — the project was created without them.
warn.generic: The project was created with a warning.

err.tool_missing: The yt-dlp component is not installed: download it in Settings → Models.
err.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg is not installed: download it in Settings → Models.
err.bad_url: This is not a link to a video: paste the full http(s) address.
err.unsupported_url: yt-dlp does not know this site, or this is not a video page.
err.playlist: This is a playlist or a channel: paste the link of one video.
err.live: A live stream or a premiere that has not started cannot be downloaded — try after it ends.
err.geo_blocked: The site does not show this video in your country: turn on a proxy in a country where it is available.
err.age_restricted: The video is age-restricted: add cookies.txt from a browser signed in to an adult account.
err.login_required: The site wants a signed-in user (or a “not a bot” check): add cookies.txt from a browser signed in to the site.
err.private: The video is private: only an account it is shared with can download it — add that account's cookies.txt.
err.members_only: The video is for the channel's members: add cookies.txt from a member's browser.
err.drm: The video is DRM-protected and cannot be downloaded.
err.unavailable: The video is removed or unavailable: check the link.
err.rate_limited: The site limits requests from your address: wait a little, add cookies.txt or use another proxy.
err.proxy: The proxy does not answer: check it in the network settings or turn it off.
err.network: The site does not answer: check the connection or the proxy.
err.cookies_invalid: This is not a cookies.txt file: export it again with a cookies.txt browser extension.
err.format_unavailable: There is no format of this quality: choose another quality.
err.no_audio: The video has no sound track: choose a video quality instead of “Audio only”.
err.outdated: This yt-dlp can no longer read the site: update it.
err.disk_space: Not enough free disk space for the video.
err.interrupted: The download stopped when the app closed.
err.update_failed: The new yt-dlp did not pass its check — the previous one stays in use.
err.io: The studio could not write a file: check the disk.

google.keyHint: Direct Google TTS and Batch; stored separately from settings.
google.savedKey: Key saved; enter a new one to replace it
google.batchHint: Google queues the batch (target: 24 hours). Cancelling the local job pauses polling; the remote batch continues. Resume retrieves it without another paid submission. Usage and estimated cost: project_google_tts_report in MCP.
google.standardHint: Parallel direct requests using the cloud concurrency setting. Usage and estimated cost: project_google_tts_report in MCP.

hub.why: How many people use Speech Studio and what for helps decide what to work on next. Nothing personal: no videos, texts, voices or file names — only counts of jobs, the models each stage used, the version, the graphics card class and why a job failed, with paths, names and quoted text cut out on this computer before it is sent.
hub.byEnv: Turned off by DO_NOT_TRACK or STUDIO_TELEMETRY in the environment.
hub.nothing: Nothing is waiting to be sent today.
hub.feedNever: News have not been fetched from the server yet: the studio shows the news of its release.

modes.label: Mode
modes.listeningHint: Recognise speech and check a voicing (Ctrl+2)
modes.speechLead: Turn a text into speech with a voice from your library, a voice cloned from a short recording or a cloud voice.

Several takes of a line, compared side by side
Stress, the Russian letter yo and abbreviations under your control
Export to WAV, FLAC, MP3 and subtitles

A voicing from Speech checked word by word against its text
Export to TXT, SRT, VTT and DOCX
